# S37 — Notification tap opens the tracker

**Findings:** ReminderScheduler.kt:78-84 (no contentIntent); MainActivity.kt (no intent handling) · **Size:** S · **Tree:** reminders

**2026-10-04** — Ready for review: reminder notifications carry immutable activity intents keyed by tracker id; singleTop MainActivity handles initial and new intents, and saved ViewModel selection drives detail navigation. Verified 118 unit tests, all 16 existing NavigationTest cases, and all 6 NotificationNavigationTest cases on the API 34 emulator. Manual two-minute reminder checks passed from the background and while another tracker was open: correct detail, one MainActivity, Back to dashboard. adb am start with tracker_id 1 opened tracker 1. The first new-test run exposed a duplicate-text assertion in the test helper; corrected and all six S37 tests passed on rerun. No ViewModel change or new dependencies.

**Not in this slice:** the notification action buttons (a later item) and the notification small icon (S12).

## Why

Tapping a reminder notification does nothing, because the notification has no `contentIntent`. The user should land on the tracker the reminder is about.

## Files

- `app/src/main/java/com/squalor/consecutor/ReminderScheduler.kt`
- `app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`
- `app/src/main/java/com/squalor/consecutor/MainActivity.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/squalor/consecutor/TrackerViewModel.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/squalor/consecutor/MainScreen.kt`

## Failing tests

- None on the JVM. Manual check with `adb`.

## Implement

1. In `showNotification`, build a `PendingIntent.getActivity(context, trackerId.toInt(), intent, FLAG_IMMUTABLE or FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT)` where `intent = Intent(context, MainActivity::class.java).putExtra(EXTRA_TRACKER_ID, trackerId)`, and call `setContentIntent(...)` on the builder. The request code is the tracker id, so each tracker has its own intent.
2. Add `android:launchMode="singleTop"` to the `MainActivity` element.
3. In `MainActivity`, add `private fun handleIntent(intent: Intent?)`: read `EXTRA_TRACKER_ID` with `getLongExtra(..., -1L)` and, if it is not -1, call `viewModel.select(id)`. Call it from `onCreate` only when `savedInstanceState == null`, and from `onNewIntent` after `setIntent(intent)`.
4. The ViewModel's selected id is the source of truth for navigation (S07 exposes `viewModel.selectedId`, and S10's back handling calls `select(null)`). In `MainScreen`, if a local `selectedTrackerId` variable still exists, remove it and read `selectedId` from the ViewModel. Add `LaunchedEffect(selectedId) { if (selectedId != null) screen = Screen.DETAIL }` so a notification tap navigates even when the app is already open on the dashboard.
5. If the tracker no longer exists, the existing "Tracker not found." state is acceptable. Back returns to the dashboard.

## Check

- Create a tracker with a reminder 2 minutes out, tap the notification, and the tracker detail opens. Back returns to the dashboard.
- With the app already open on another tracker, a second notification tap switches to the right tracker without starting a second activity.
- `adb shell am start -n com.squalor.consecutor/.MainActivity --el tracker_id 1` opens tracker 1.
